importantNotes: Ruth is one of only two books in the Bible named after a woman (along with Esther).
Ruth the Moabitess is in the genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:5).
Boaz is a 'kinsman-redeemer' — a beautiful type of Christ who redeems us.
The story shows God's grace extends beyond Israel to all nations.
Ruth's famous declaration of loyalty (1:16-17) is among the most beloved passages in Scripture.

chapters.1: Naomi loses her husband and sons in Moab; Ruth pledges loyalty and returns with her to Bethlehem.
chapters.2: Ruth gleans in Boaz's field; Boaz shows her kindness and protection.
chapters.3: At Naomi's instruction, Ruth approaches Boaz at the threshing floor, asking him to redeem her.
chapters.4: Boaz redeems Ruth and marries her; their son Obed is the grandfather of King David.
